dataset_title: Peak Country Northern Colorado Hail History Dataset, 2016–2025
publisher: Peak Country Auto Hail Repair & Paintless Dent Repair
scientific_identity: All four master formats represent the same 1,844 observation identities and 34 public fields; subsets, summaries and figures are derived representations, not additional observations.

license_scope.database: ODC-By 1.0 applies only to protectable Peak Country compilation/database rights, if any
license_scope.content: CC BY 4.0 applies only to protectable Peak Country-original expression, if any
license_scope.source: CoCoRaHS CC BY 3.0 is independently preserved; U.S. federal facts remain public domain; other third-party rights are not conveyed
license_scope.trademarks: Peak Country names, logos and brand identifiers are reserved

known_limitations: Observations are not unique storms or proof of individual property damage
MRMS is unavailable for 2016–2019 and partial from 2020-10-14
The release does not establish a climate trend or normalized risk
NWS original archive coverage is incomplete and the SPC 2022-02-24 retrieval has a documented gap

checksum_manifests.scope: All public files except SHA256SUMS.txt and release-manifest.json; includes the finalized CHECKSUMS.sha256 file
Core data, summaries, figures and machine-readable artifacts

checksum_exclusions: release-manifest.json is excluded from SHA256SUMS.txt to avoid a circular release-manifest hash dependency
